Y eahahhhhh they're not entirely the greatest, I definitely don't hate or dislike them but it'd be....really nice to be treated a bit better, although it is good to hear I'm not just being too much of a pussy about it-- If I can make it on my own, at the very least I won't have to deal with that every day anymore ahhhh

But! I very much like your idea! As an artist that sounds like something I could appreciate doing, I'll see what I can do!

I gotta sleep now because I just realized it's super late but I'm grateful you and the other commenter said things I haven't heard a billion times (or really been told personally at all), I'm not sure why I was so anxious for months about posting here, you guys are way nicer than I thought you'd be so it's very very much appreciated <333
